mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, an unusually negative completed Pastor-Stambaugh-style liquidity gamma means direction-signed turnover is producing next-bar reversal after controlling current return, identifying temporary price impact; fade the completed four-hour displacement for twelve hours at a fresh illiquidity-tail onset.
mechanism.side: short a strictly positive completed trailing four-hour return and long a strictly negative return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPST regresses next five-minute return on current return and current direction-signed, block-mean-normalized quote turnover inside a completed day. Kyle-style candidates use contemporaneous signed-flow impact; turnover lead-response uses unconditional turnover/next-return association; Roll uses return autocovariance. HVPST isolates the incremental next-return reversal coefficient and uses no OI, funding, fitted postentry outcome, reused event, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both the negative-gamma illiquidity magnitude and completed realized variation must occupy causal upper tails, targeting temporary impact during July-like stress
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour completed liquidity-gamma onsets with twelve-hour reservations are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 288 exact completed BTCUSDT five-minute bars [T-24h,T), each from five coherent one-minute rows
features.return: log five-minute close/open, strict sign required for signed-turnover regressor
features.signed_turnover: sign(return)*quote_asset_volume/mean quote_asset_volume over the completed block
features.regression: OLS next_return=a+b*current_return+gamma*signed_turnover on the first 287 bars, full rank and finite
features.illiquidity: -gamma, requiring gamma<0 and finite positive illiquidity
features.illiquidity_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.direction: strict completed trailing four-hour close/open return
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 288 five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.event: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid decision ineligible

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source block
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published temporary-impact liquidity gamma under independently fixed causal tail gates

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no regression, scaling, rank, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: within 288 completed five-minute bars, regress r[t+1] on intercept, r[t], and sign(r[t])*quote_turnover[t]/block mean quote turnover; negative signed-turnover coefficient gamma represents temporary price impact and greater -gamma is lower liquidity
external_basis.selection_use: published lead regression, return control, signed-volume construction, and negative-gamma interpretation only; no candidate incidence or outcomes
